In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
item.description: <p>We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Planner, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
item.description: <p>Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Outlook, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
item.description: <p>Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: OneDrive: Manage access to the OneDrive Photos Desktop experience
item.description: <p>OneDrive is adding administrative controls for the Photos experience on Windows. Organizations can manage whether users sign in with personal Microsoft accounts. These controls help IT teams align OneDrive Photos with their access, data governance, and device-management requirements.</p> (GA: August CY2026) — OneDrive

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents
item.description: <p>Agents that are published to Agents 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.</p> (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Excel: Get and transform data with Copilot in Excel
item.description: <p>Get your data ready, just by asking. Describe the data you need and how you want it prepared, and the new get data skill handles the rest. It can connect and transform your data, then load the results into your workbook using Power Query, giving you a query you can inspect, edit, and refresh with (GA: October CY2026) — Excel

item.title: Planner: Task History
item.description: <p>Task History helps keep teams up to date on changes made to a task. View recent activity to see what changed, when it changed, and track progress over time.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Planner
